creator.name: Abhishek Devendra Limaye
creator.bio: Cybersecurity and digital forensics practitioner specializing in evidence-driven analysis, digital forensic evidence handling, log forensics, SIEM alert triage, and UAV/firmware security engineering. Passionate about blue-team operations, digital forensics and incident response (DFIR), and empirical vulnerability assessment.
focusAreas: Host & Network Forensic Analysis (Linux, macOS, Windows)
Firmware Reverse Engineering & Embedded Systems Security
Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) & MAVLink Protocol Auditing

macOS Unified Logs, sysdiagnose, and security auditing
File carving & cryptographic hash verification (MD5, SHA-256)
Wireshark packet capture analysis & telemetry protocol decoding
developmentAndTooling: Python (forensic scripting, protocol parsers, telemetry auditing)
JavaScript / React / Node.js (security tooling, full-stack portfolios)

keyProjects.name: SECUREDRONE (UAV-Security-Lab)
keyProjects.summary: An open-source, empirical UAV security research and assessment platform. Features headless PX4 SITL simulation, MAVLink 2 cryptographic signature validation, replay attack resilience evaluation, STM32F767 firmware reverse engineering with Ghidra, offline RF 2-GFSK IQ demodulation, and cyber-physical GNSS spoofing detection with Chi-squared innovation monitoring.
keyProjects.deliverables: 5-page publication-grade LaTeX technical report, 40+ page comprehensive manual, 3,748-frame Wireshark PCAPs, automated 13-test regression suite.

keyProjects.name: MacHeimdall
keyProjects.summary: macOS Intrusion Detection and Log Forensic Analysis platform. Analyzes macOS Unified Logs, authentication traces, process lifecycles, and authorization mechanisms to uncover suspicious activity in Apple ecosystems.

keyProjects.name: SentinelSOC
keyProjects.summary: Security Operations Center (SOC) framework and integration scripts designed to automate alert triaging, streamline detection rule deployments, and manage incident response workflows.

keyProjects.name: SmartDeck
keyProjects.summary: Open-source digital forensics orchestration tool for automating evidence acquisition across endpoints, maintaining reproducible audit trails, and accelerating triage.

keyProjects.name: Abhishek-cyber-lab
keyProjects.summary: A collection of hands-on cybersecurity lab environments, network topologies, vulnerability assessments, and defensive walkthroughs.

philosophy: Evidence-Driven Security: Claims must be backed by reproducible execution output, cryptographic hashes, or forensic packet captures.
Read-Only Principle: Forensic investigation must preserve the untouched state of original media.
Honest Scope: Real security engineers acknowledge tool limitations, avoid security through obscurity, and state boundaries clearly.
